description: Create a new server instance. For KVM (Gen3): use serverImageNo + serverSpecCode. For XEN (Gen2): use serverImageProductCode + serverProductCode, or serverImageNo + serverSpecCode. Use dryRun=true to preview without creating.

associateWithPublicIp.description: Associate a new public IP on creation

dryRun.description: If true, returns a preview without actually creating the server

feeSystemTypeCode.description: Fee system type (MTRAT: hourly, FXSUM: monthly)

loginKeyName.description: Login key name for SSH access

memberServerImageInstanceNo.description: Member server image instance number (custom image)

ip.description: Specific IP address for this NIC

serverImageNo.description: Server image number from ncloud_get_server_images (required for KVM/Gen3)

serverImageProductCode.description: Server image product code (legacy, XEN/RHV only)

serverProductCode.description: Server product code (legacy, XEN/RHV only, use with serverImageProductCode)

serverSpecCode.description: Server spec code from ncloud_get_server_specs (required for KVM/Gen3, e.g., c2-g3, s2-g3)

name: ncloud_create_server
